reason: The hypothesis makes specific claims about the relationship between compositional descriptors and thermal conductivity mechanisms, and about the superiority of the proposed ML approach over existing models, but cites no prior evidence to support any of these key premises.
premises: Atomic size mismatch, mixing entropy, and electronic structure parameters robustly capture lattice distortions and grain boundary scattering mechanisms that reduce thermal conductivity in HEAs.
Explicit incorporation of these descriptors into an ML framework will enable significantly improved predictions of phonon thermal conductivity.
Current predictive models (CALPHAD, rule-of-mixtures) rely on averaged or less detailed compositional descriptors and yield lower accuracy.
The approach is applicable to single-phase metallic HEAs with uniform microstructures.
